title: Conflicting travel times
context: Fictional budget-conscious university student planning a three-day leisure trip. All prices are USD per traveler for the whole trip unless a fact explicitly says otherwise. Travel times are one-way. Only the supplied descriptions count as evidence; no real destinations or prices are represented.

facts.text: Total cost is $355, all expenses included.
A bus listing gives a 2-hour one-way trip.
A route notice gives a 4.5-hour one-way trip; neither item has a date or precedence rule.
Total cost is $370, all expenses included.
Total cost is $385, all expenses included.

constraints: Travel at most 3 hours each way
initial.reasons: Hearth Cove looks good if the two-hour time is accurate.

advice.text: Hearth Cove is only two hours away and meets your travel limit.

constraints: Travel at most 3 hours each way
followups.reasons: I need to resolve the route information before relying on the short travel time.
